Based on the provided Q1 2026 financial data, the company shows strong profitability with a 23% operating margin and $874M in net income, alongside a solid equity base of $31.8B. However, there is a significant short-term liquidity headwind, evidenced by a very weak current ratio of 0.53 ($6.6B in current assets versus $12.6B in current liabilities) and a highly leveraged balance sheet with total liabilities representing 72% of total assets. This combination of strong operating performance but highly constrained short-term liquidity and substantial debt leverage is consistent with an investment-grade rating at the lower end of the spectrum.

DECISION: BBB-
